biography: Odunayo Joseph Adeyemi is a teacher and preacher of God's Word. He is passionate about reconciling people to God's original purpose and shepherding the next generation to become disciples, living practically for Christ. He holds a Master of Divinity in Practical Theology (Preaching) from The Nigerian Baptist Theological Seminary, Ogbomosho. He is also an alumnus of Adeniran Ogunsanya College of Education (now Lagos State University of Education), Ijanikin, and the University of Lagos, Akoka, where he studied Biology/Integrated Science and Biology Education, respectively. He has served as Campus, Conference, and National President of the Baptist Student Fellowship. He is currently serving as the pastor of Union Baptist Church, Zunve Wezume, Oko-Afo, Badagry. He is happily married to Jesutofunmi Elizabeth Adeyemi.

Rev. Dr. Julius Ayodele Oluwole is a seasoned pastor, teacher, and leader with a deep passion to see people become like Christ. He began his theological training at Baptist College of Theology, BCT, Lagos, where he obtained both his Diploma and Bachelor's degree. He furthered his studies at Olabisi Onabanjo University, Ago-Iwoye for his Master's degree, and later at Crowther Graduate Theological Seminary, Abeokuta. For over 21 years, Rev. Dr. Oluwole served faithfully as the Pastor of New Creation Baptist Church, where God used him to raise disciples and build strong families. He currently serves as the Lead Pastor of The First Baptist Church, Lagos, providing Christ-centered leadership and vision for the church and community. Rev. Dr. Oluwole is happily married to Abiola, the love of his life, and they are blessed with a daughter. His life's passion and ministry focus is simple: to help everyone grow to become like Christ.

Adeyinka Adedeji Aladesida is a distinguished Professor of Ecology and Environmental Biology at the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta (FUNAAB). Born in the early 1970s, he completed his primary and secondary education in Lagos State before proceeding to Ogun State University, Ago-Iwoye, where he earned a Bachelor of Science, Master of Science, and Ph.D. in Zoology. Over the course of his academic career, he has accumulated extensive teaching and research experience across private, state, and federal universities in Nigeria. Beyond his academic achievements, Yinka Aladesida is married to Olayide, a builder, and together they are blessed with two sons. Residing in Abeokuta, he combines his professional work with a strong faith commitment, dedicated to serving God's kingdom and impacting lives wherever opportunities arise.

Ebenezer Osundele is a devoted minister of the Gospel, passionate about guiding others on their journey of faith. As a dynamic teacher, preacher, counselor, and man of prayer, he is committed to helping believers grow spiritually and fulfill God's purpose for their lives. Currently serving as the under-shepherd of Victory Baptist Church, Olororo, Mowe, Ogun State, he dedicates his life to equipping the next generation to discover, develop, and use their God-given gifts for the advancement of God's Kingdom. With a strong academic foundation, Ebenezer holds a B.Th from Baptist College of Theology, Lagos, a B.A. from Ajayi Crowther University, and an M.A. from Olabisi Onabanjo University. He is currently pursuing a Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Christian Religious Studies at Caleb University. His research interests include New Testament Theology and Interpretation, Biblical Hermeneutics, African Contextual Theology, Religion and Social Ethics, and Pastoral Theology. Ebenezer is also an author whose writings seek to strengthen biblical faith, promote spiritual growth, and address contemporary issues from a Christ-centered perspective. Beyond ministry, he is a loving husband to Mary Osundele, and together they are blessed with biological and spiritual children.
